quests.title: A Fresh Start
dialogue: Springfield could use a neighbourhood with a little more greenery.
First things first: let's get a cottage built.

quests.title: Bloom Where You're Planted
dialogue: Those lawns look a bit bare. Time for some colour!

quests.title: Good Fences
dialogue: A few fences should make this street look a little more welcoming.

quests.title: You've Got Mail
dialogue: A proper neighbourhood needs somewhere for all those bills to arrive.

quests.title: Grand Opening
dialogue: Now let's give everyone a reason to visit Maple Heights.
